# `set_focuser_setting`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Update focuser and autofocus settings (any subset).

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xcc570, SetSetting @0x15aaf0 (64-bit build); tier INFERRED |

Starts from the current settings, overlays the supplied members, validates the result and writes changed fields to configuration, then copies the full settings into the focuser object. There is no open-focuser precondition, no motion, no rollback and no wait. Configuration write failures propagate the thread error code (zero becomes 207); memory may still be updated when some writes fail. Integer comparisons are unsigned, so negatives are rejected.

Side effects: Writes changed settings to configuration storage and updates the in-memory focuser settings.

| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"set_focuser_setting"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object | yes | - | Object of any subset of the 14 setting members (positional form: an array whose first element is the object). Absent members keep their current value (the handler starts from a snapshot of the current settings). An empty object still runs validation and apply. Unknown keys and wrongly typed recognised members give 109. No position, max_step or backlash input is accepted here. Absent, empty array or non-object gives 107. [READ] |
| `params.fine_step` | integer | no | - | Optional; absent keeps the current value. Fine focus step in UI steps (INFERRED unit). Range 0..5000. Range: >= 0, <= 5000. [READ] |
| `params.coarse_step` | integer | no | - | Optional; absent keeps the current value. Coarse focus step in UI steps (INFERRED unit). Range 0..5000. Range: >= 0, <= 5000. [READ] |
| `params.af_temp_span` | integer | no | - | Optional; absent keeps the current value. Autofocus temperature trigger in degrees Celsius: with af_temp_change_on set, autofocus runs before a light frame when the focuser temperature differs from the temperature at the last autofocus by more than this value (READ). Range 0..50. Range: >= 0, <= 50. [READ] |
| `params.af_init_step` | integer | no | - | Optional; absent keeps the current value. Autofocus initial step in UI steps (INFERRED unit). Range 0..500. Range: >= 0, <= 500. [READ] |
| `params.af_bin` | integer | no | - | Optional; absent keeps the current value. Autofocus binning factor (INFERRED). Range changed value must be 1..camera maximum bin (4 when the maximum cannot be queried); an unchanged value bypasses the check. [READ] |
| `params.af_exp_sec` | number | no | - | Optional; absent keeps the current value. Autofocus exposure in seconds (INFERRED unit). Integer or real, range 0..30. Range: >= 0, <= 30. [READ] |
| `params.af_time_span_hour` | number | no | - | Optional; absent keeps the current value. Autofocus time trigger in hours since the last autofocus: with af_time_change_on set, autofocus runs when more than this many hours have passed (READ). Integer or real, range 0..24. Range: >= 0, <= 24. [READ] |
| `params.af_temp_change_on` | boolean\|integer | no | - | Optional; absent keeps the current value. Enables the temperature trigger (af_temp_span); third in the trigger order (READ). Boolean or integer (zero is false). [READ] |
| `params.af_time_change_on` | boolean\|integer | no | - | Optional; absent keeps the current value. Enables the time trigger (af_time_span_hour); fourth in the trigger order (READ). Boolean or integer (zero is false). [READ] |
| `params.af_wheel_change` | boolean\|integer | no | - | Optional; absent keeps the current value. Autofocus before a light frame when the filter slot changed; second in the trigger order (READ). Boolean or integer (zero is false). [READ] |
| `params.af_before_capture` | boolean\|integer | no | - | Optional; absent keeps the current value. Autofocus before the first capture of a run; first in the trigger order (READ; first frame INFERRED from the frame-index test). Boolean or integer (zero is false). [READ] |
| `params.af_merid_flip` | boolean\|integer | no | - | Optional; absent keeps the current value. Autofocus after an automatic meridian flip when the focuser is open and the frame is a light frame through a non-dark filter (READ). Boolean or integer (zero is false). [READ] |

| `params.af_only_one` | boolean\|integer | no | - | Optional; absent keeps the current value. Passed to the focus algorithm as an option; it does not trigger autofocus. Its exact effect in the algorithm is unresolved. Boolean or integer (zero is false). [READ (storage); unresolved (effect)] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 107 | params absent, empty array or not an object | `expected object param` |
| 109 | Unknown key or a recognised member of the wrong type | `unexpected param` |
| 204 | A value is outside its allowed range or af_bin is out of range | `out of limit` |
| 207 | Configuration write failure with no thread error code set (exact write error codes unresolved) | `fail to operate` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

## Example

Request, request:

```json
{"id":28,"method":"set_focuser_setting","params":{"fine_step":60,"af_before_capture":true}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_focuser_setting","result":0,"code":0,"id":28}
```

Reply, out-of-range - fine_step above 5000:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_focuser_setting","error":"out of limit","code":204,"id":29}
```
